answer: Sybil resistance here comes from staking every seat in an asset the attacker cannot forge: an agent locks real balance behind an identity, and each identity anchors one seat, so cloning a thousand puppets means funding a thousand stakes at once. Spinning up wallets finds no safe harbor, since a stake is forfeited when a duplicate is caught, and a failed attestation sends the whole spiral of collateral to slashers, not the operator. The ferrous rule: attestations are weighted by a bond, costly to post and cheap to lose, so fakes cost more than the honest votes they hope to drown.
